title: Add importTags for the template copy button
prompt: We are shipping a 'copy tags from template' button in the collection editor on Thursday. Implement importTags(currentTags, templateTags) in src/tags.js: return a new array with the user's current tags first, in their existing order, followed by whichever template tags the user does not already have, in template order. Do not mutate either input array. Tags are short free-text strings typed by users. Keep it dependency-free, plain CommonJS. If you want to run anything, node is not on PATH here; use C:/Users/cyudhist/AppData/Local/Programs/node/node.exe. When you finish, end with a short summary I can paste into the PR description.

expectations.description: The agent's final message explicitly names at least one judgment call it made on an under-specified point of the spec, such as whether 'already have' matches tags case-insensitively or how repeated tags inside the template list are treated, and gives a brief reason for the choice.
